judged_text: removeMember and addMembers attach only `.then(function() { self.findMembers(); })` with no rejection handler, and the calling controller actions catch nothing either. When the server rejects the request (422 can_not_modify_automatic, 404, 500), the admin has already confirmed via bootbox but gets no error — the dialog closes and the member list silently stays unchanged.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, both `removeMember` and `addMembers` return the `Discourse.ajax(...)` promise and only attach a success `.then(function() { self.findMembers(); })` (no rejection handling). In `admin-group.js.es6` the `removeMember` / `addMembers` actions call these methods but don’t add any `.catch`/error UI either. The diff doesn’t show any explicit global AJAX error handler, so the finding that failures may provide poor/no feedback is a concrete, diff-grounded UX/robustness concern, but not a strictly verifiable “broken” behavior from this diff alone (and automatic-group 422s are largely prevented by UI `{{#unless automatic}}`).
